newsitem.title: UK: Moody's says may cut Aaa ratings of Winterthur.
newsitem.headline: Moody's says may cut Aaa ratings of Winterthur.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Tuesday it had placed its Aaa insurance financial strength rating of Winterthur Swiss Insurance Company under review for possible downgrade.

The rating agency also said it had placed under review for possible downgrade its Aaa guaranteed senior unsecured debt of Winterthur Finance Ltd, which is unconditionally and irrevocably guaranteed by Winterthur Insurance WINZ.S.
Moody's said its review would focus on the solvency pressures arising from Winterthur's acquisition strategy, and the lessening quality of its earnings.

"Moody's rating review will emphasise the effect that acquisitions have had on the capital structure of Winterthur, the role of future acquisitions in the group's strategy, and management's plans regarding its current and future capitalisation," the agency said in a statement.

It said the review would also consider management's ability to enhance future earnings in the context of increased shareholder pressures, heightened competition in the main markets in which the group operates, and the costs associated with its multiple-integration process.
Moody's said Winterthur is one of the leading insurance companies in Europe, and has attained strong positions in global insurance markets.

"In recent years, however, market conditions and its strategy of growth by acquisition, mostly financed with internal resources and debt, have made the capitalisation of Winterthur depart from the levels seen at its peers," Moody's said.

"Capital formation has been modest, and profitability has relied strongly on investment gains. Further, the core- profitability outlook is not positive, as tariff liberalisation in Europe, Winterthur's main market, may depress underwriting margins."
Moody's said it had placed the following ratings under review:
-- Winterthur Swiss Insurance Company -- Aaa rating for insurance financial strength.
-- Winterthur Finance Limited -- Aaa rating for its guaranteed long- term senior unsecured debt.
